- Boolean type true/false.
- Array type: node is array, schema type ARRAY.
- Object type: node is object, schema type OBJECT.

- Node is textual "true" as string vs boolean true.

- Parent schema with format "date-time" might affect string? Not needed.

- ValidationContext with "typeLoose" false but also "typeLoose" true for number vs integer.

- Schema type is BOOLEAN, node boolean true.

- Schema type is ARRAY, node is array with elements of various types.

- Schema type is OBJECT, node is object.

- Node is missing (null) and schema type is something else: should be false.

- Schema type is NULL, node is NullNode; already covered.

- Schema type is NULL, node is non-null: should be false.

- Parent schema overrides to null? maybe parent schema type null.

- Test when validationContext has option "typeLoose" false (default) but node is integer and schema type is NUMBER; should be true (integer is number). Already not covered.

- Test when validationContext has "typeLoose" true and node is number (float) and schema type is INTEGER; maybe still false.

- Test with JsonType.ANY (if exists). Not sure.

We'll assume representation strings for values.

We'll produce groups:

1. "Number type handling"
   - integer node with schemaType NUMBER (no parent, default context) -> true
   - floating node with schemaType NUMBER -> true
   - floating node with schemaType INTEGER -> false
   - integer node with schemaType INTEGER -> true (already covered but we can still maybe not duplicate). Already covered integer matching, but not number case.

2. "Boolean type handling"

   - node integer, schemaType INTEGER, parentSchema with null type, default context -> true

   - node NullNode, schemaType BOOLEAN -> false (already similar to null with STRING). Not duplicate.

But they already have null with STRING false; we can add null with BOOLEAN false.

8. "Schema type ANY (if exists)" - uncertain.

Better to stick to clear cases.

Make sure not duplicate existing ones: they already have integer matching, mismatching integer vs string, null with NULL true/false, undefined schemaType null, parent schema overrides, validationContext typeLoose for string/integer.

So new cases: number handling, boolean, array, object, parent schema null type, null node with BOOLEAN, floating vs integer.
